question.text: The key investment team of an AIF Manager must have at least one person with which NISM certification?

answer.text: NISM Series V-A: Mutual Fund Distributors
NISM Series XIX-C or XIX-D: AIF Managers

explanation.text: The Logic: At least one key personnel in the key investment team of the Manager of a Category I and/or Category II AIF must hold either NISM-Series-XIX-C or NISM-Series-XIX-D certification. The same key personnel must also satisfy the specified professional qualification requirement. The Trap: Both requirements (NISM certification and the specified professional qualification) must be fulfilled by the same key personnel. Note: This requirement is set out at the AIF Manager / key investment team level under the workbook.
